title: Not signed in
notes: Staff lists include hidden and inactive units. `filter[...]` accepts: project_id, building_id, status, unit_type_id, active, rooms. `q` searches unit number, code and CRM id. `price_min`/`price_max` filter `price_in_tax`. Sort fields: id, unit_number, price_in_tax, status, updated_at.

nameAr: The name in Arabic field is required.
nameEn: The name in English field is required.

title: Idempotency key missing
notes: Requires `Idempotency-Key`. Creates the reservation as `pending` (or `active` when the unit has no reservation fee). `expires_at` is set only when a hold time is configured. 409 `UNIT_NOT_AVAILABLE` if the unit is taken.

examples.title: Reserve a unit that is taken

error.message: The unit is not available for reservation.

title: Policy not configured
notes: 409 `POLICY_NOT_CONFIGURED` (D-07) until the price basis is configured. Amounts add up to the exact price; the rounding remainder is on the last installment. Regenerating is refused once any installment is paid.

error.message: Policy 'installments.price_basis' is not configured yet (decision D-07).

title: Create a tenant
notes: Checked against the mandate: a `services_only` mandate answers 403 `MANDATE_SCOPE` with `details.reason`.

title: Create a service request
notes: Requires `Idempotency-Key`. Eligibility is checked: `warranty` needs an active warranty, `paid` needs a unit sold by Alawaly, `facility` needs current ownership. Failure: 422 `NOT_ELIGIBLE` with `details.reasons[]`.

error.message: After-sales services are available to owners of units sold by Alawaly.

title: Update a unit (optimistic lock)
notes: Only a whitelist of fields is writable. `status`, prices, `client_id` and `version` answer `FIELD_NOT_WRITABLE`. A stale `If-Match` answers `409 VERSION_CONFLICT` with `details.current_version`: reload and ask the user to re-apply.

error.message: The unit was changed by someone else.

title: Staff login
notes: Rate limited (429 `RATE_LIMITED`). Wrong password, unknown email and inactive account all answer the same `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`. Keep the token in memory or a secure store; send `permissions` to your permission context.

title: Get a unit (note the ETag)
notes: The `ETag` header is the unit's `version`. Send it back as `If-Match` when editing.

title: Change unit status
notes: Targets allowed here: available, unavailable, hidden. Reserved/sold are set by reservations and sales. Leaving `sold` needs the `inventory.status.override` permission. Requires `Idempotency-Key`.

title: Request a price change
notes: Fields: price_ex_tax, price_in_tax, price_total, promotion_price, reservation_amount. Nothing changes until a different person approves.

title: Approve a price change (a different person)
notes: The approver must not be the requester (`FOUR_EYES_REQUIRED`).

examples.title: Approve a price change (a different person)

title: Import units: dry run
notes: `dry_run` defaults to true. Prices are not importable. Unknown CRM ids are reported under `skipped`. The commit is idempotent by payload hash.

title: Extend the hold
notes: Answers 409 `POLICY_NOT_CONFIGURED` (decision D-06) until a hold duration is configured.

title: Initiate an offline payment
notes: `provider`: `offline` (always available) or `generic_hmac` (only when a gateway secret is configured, else 409 `PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED`). Exactly one of `payment_id` or `reservation_id`. The amount defaults to the amount due and must equal it.

session.instructions: Pay by bank transfer or at a branch, then upload the receipt. Staff will confirm the payment.

session.note: Redirect/session creation is provider specific and not implemented.

title: Confirm an offline payment (first approver)
notes: First approver. Creates a `pending_second_approval` transaction. Nothing is marked paid yet. `method`: bank_transfer, cash, cheque.

title: Approve the confirmation (second approver)
notes: Second approver, a different person (`FOUR_EYES_REQUIRED`). Marks the installment paid or activates the reservation.

title: Gateway callback (signed by the gateway)
notes: Called by the payment gateway, not by the UI. Public, signed with HMAC-SHA256 in `X-Signature`. Duplicates answer 200 `duplicate`; late or out-of-order events are ignored.

title: Refund (recorded)
notes: Records the refund (bounded by what was paid). It does not call the gateway. Requires `Idempotency-Key`.

examples.title: Get a payment with its transactions

title: Create a sale from a reservation
notes: Requires `Idempotency-Key`. With a `reservation_id` the reservation must be open and belong to the same client and unit. The unit becomes `sold`.

examples.title: Create a sale from a reservation

title: Transition without a contract
notes: `to`: contracted (needs a contract document), paid_up (every installment paid or waived), handed_over (owner accepted the handover).

title: Upload the contract (multipart)
notes: multipart/form-data: `type` (contract, annex, id, other) and `file` (pdf, jpg, png, max 10 MB). Each upload creates the next version of that type.

title: Get a signed download link
notes: Returns a signed URL valid for 10 minutes. Open it directly (no Authorization header needed). Never cache it.
